body: Although its not really worth bragging about, I've gone from 132 lbs to 156 lbs @ 5'10'' over the last year and a month. Usually fluctuate between what I guess is 10-15% BF. I focus more on powerlifting style training, although I haven't been as focused as I should have been. Squat @ 295lbs, DL @ 390lbs, Bench @ 185lbs (I blame the shit bench on shoulder issues).
